idea-plugin.name: Ow Language
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for the Ow programming language (.ow files): file-type recognition with the Ow icon, syntax highlighting (keywords, the module system, built-in functions including the dictionary/map builtins, strings, numbers, operators and comments), and a Run .ow File action.

The Ow runtime is bundled — the Run action works out of the box using the IDE's own Java, so you don't have to install Ow separately. If you do have ow on your PATH, that install is used instead. See ow-lang.

action.description: Run the current Ow file with the installed `ow` command
